prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1488; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a collision during a left turn. The front bumper cover is cracked across the center, the left headlamp assembly is broken, and the hood shows a crease with paint loss along the leading edge. The left fender has a dented radiator support area that will need partial replacement and alignment. Damage pattern is largely consistent with the reported impact direction. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to us. The repair plan covers replacing the bumper cover and headlamp, straightening the hood, and refinishing affected panels. Labor hours submitted fit the scope of the damage, and the invoices show no repeated charges for the same work.
